editions.title: Week of July 27, 2026
editions.hook: Alphabet put revenue numbers on ads inside AI answers, the EU's AI-labeling deadline landed a week out with 3%-of-turnover fines, ChatGPT Ads shipped real performance tooling, and new data showed buying an AI placement doesn't buy the citation.
editions.description: Ads inside AI search become a disclosed revenue line at Alphabet; the EU AI Act's August 2 labeling deadline arrives with fines up to 3% of turnover; ChatGPT Ads matures into a performance channel with a dark auction underneath; Similarweb documents a fragmenting assistant market; WARC locates the AI creative problem in the brief.
